description: Run the commerce pipeline once: pull catalogs and competitor prices, match them, apply the policies and draft price proposals. By default it is a dry run that drafts proposals and pushes nothing to a store. With execute true it also pushes approved proposals to the connected store, which changes live prices and needs the commerce execute scope as well. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce proposal draft scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

execute.description: Push approved proposals to the store. Defaults to false.

expires_in_seconds.description: How long drafted proposals stay open, up to 30 days.

name: run_commerce_cycle
